ITEM 1 | Shredded light-brown and golden fried strands with darker crispy brown edges and some caramelized bits, clumped in a loose mound in the upper-middle of the plate, dry and crisp-looking, about 9 cm across and 1.5 cm tall, covering roughly 20% of the plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-cream, finely crumbled soft mass with a grainy, slightly moist texture and small curds, spread across the lower-right of the plate in an irregular heap about 9 cm across and 1.5 cm high, sitting beside the other items | 110
ITEM 3 | Bright yellow cubes of fruit with a slightly glossy, juicy surface, cut into rough wedge-shaped chunks about 2.5 to 3 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, five pieces clustered at the lower-left edge of the plate | 85
